title: Applied Moire: from geometric claim to language-model substrate
summary: This pass follows one of the few branches where the early geometric-interference story was pushed into ordinary machine learning at nontrivial scale. It keeps three stages separate: an early Moire neural-network demo whose strongest XOR/inevitable-oscillation claims were later killed, a One Formula synthesis whose physics leg failed a later null while its EEG and AI legs remained live, and MoireFormer as a 137.9M engineering artifact whose existence is stronger evidence than the biological interpretation wrapped around it.

nodes.claim: An early attempt to replace explicit pairwise weights with frequency/angle/phase grid parameters whose geometric interference supplies nonlinear effective coupling, paired with the original PerceptionLab ECG feedback loop.
nodes.survived: The repository packaged two durable experimental objects: an inspectable geometric-interference network and the checkerboard/sampling/homeostasis loop that later audits mechanized into a finite-resolution regime map. It is useful as an ancestor because the code made the later falsification possible.
nodes.killed: The later Deerskin audit shows that the reported XOR advantage over an MLP was a restart-budget artifact under unmatched initialization budget, and the strong claim that finite-resolution self-observation must oscillate is false because fixed/dead regimes exist.

nodes.claim: A synthesis repo asserting that the real Hermitian phase-coherence score Re[Q conj(K)] connects wave-field memory, schizophrenia EEG geometry and Moire attention.
nodes.survived: The synthesis usefully isolates one mathematical operation across the three experiments. Its EEG leg records the same p=0.007, d=-1.21 zero-trained-parameter result, and its AI leg records a controlled 16M WikiText-2 comparison where the Moire arm ended 0.115 loss lower after five epochs before the idea was scaled further.
nodes.killed: The wave-memory leg is no longer an independent proof: the later no-probe and wrong-phase controls show the claimed retrieval did not depend on the probe physics. The AI comparison also had about 4% more parameters in the Moire model, only two training runs, no full statistical test, and no independent ablation of theta gating versus phase scoring.

nodes.claim: A custom language-model implementation that replaces the standard attention score path with amplitude/phase projections and geometric interference, scaled to a 12-layer 137.9M-parameter model with a live chat artifact.
nodes.survived: The strongest fact is engineering rather than biological: the repository contains a 137.9M-parameter custom Moire attention-style model, training/inference code and published weights/live demo, showing the mechanism can be implemented at ordinary language-model scale and produce nontrivial language behavior.
nodes.killed: The artifact does not establish superiority over parameter-matched standard attention, does not prove that biological ephaptic phase coupling is the mechanism being exploited, and does not show that phase interference is necessary rather than one reparameterization of a trainable attention computation.

edges.why: The later Deerskin audit directly re-tests the matching MoireNet XOR and ECG/self-observation claims, but it does not explicitly name this repository as code provenance, so the correction link is kept below high confidence.

One Formula packages the Geometric-Neuron wave-memory, EEG and Moire-attention experiments into a single formula-centered synthesis and identifies the Geometric-Neuron repository as its source repository.
MoireFormer explicitly points to Geometric-Neuron as the theory/background origin of the architecture and says it was inspired by the Geometric Neuron / Deerskin concepts.

motifs.title: One formula, three very different evidential fates
motifs.description: The Hermitian phase-coherence motif is useful precisely because the branches do not all survive equally: wave-memory retrieval is killed by a no-probe null, the EEG signal remains an empirical small-cohort result needing replication, and the AI branch becomes a trainable 137.9M engineering artifact without thereby validating the biological story.

motifs.title: A working artifact can survive after its motivating metaphor is narrowed
motifs.description: The applied Moire line is most defensible when separated into mechanism and interpretation: an attention-like phase/interference parameterization can be trained and scaled even though earlier claims about inevitable oscillation, wave retrieval and biological identity are weakened or killed.
